## Batch 50 handoff

Authored the 23-item PE26 inventory, both pages, proof contracts, coverage, cross-batch dependency record, and batch notes. The proofs cover the stated 2D scalar diffusion scope; the BDDC/FETI-DP bound excludes the broader cases the design warns against.

All 23 items are recorded as **escalated** because the required PE25 page has no inspectable carrier. The unresolved interface includes the stable-decomposition and overlap hypotheses and the two-level P1 Poisson specialization. The exact gap is recorded in the [cross-batch dependency record](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-50.cross-batch-dependencies.json>).

## Checks and run status

Precheck passed for all 17 proof-bearing items; strict proof-contract validation accepted 23 contracts and 48 steps; proof layout found 0 defects; source stamps verified 3/3 sources; rendercheck reported 0 errors or warnings. The scoped dependency graph and manifest audit also passed.

The run-wide dependency checker could not parse batch 49’s manifest because of an invalid JSON escape at line 151, column 199. The batch 50 scoped graph passes. The recomputed run remains `running` at 35/71 scaffold units, with a run-level owner-repair and recertification blocker. This handoff does not claim run completion or independent approval.
